items.titleZh: AI图像增强提升倒装芯片互连缺陷检测（MCL、PVA TePla、ASE）
items.descriptionZh:
研究人员来自奥地利莱奥本材料中心（Materials Center Leoben）、PVA TePla和日月光半导体（ASE），合作发表了题为《基于AI的图像增强改善微电子封装互连缺陷检测》的论文。随着现代半导体器件持续小型化、结构复杂化，先进封装中的互连密度不断提高，传统失效分析（FA）方法在缺陷定位和判读上面临越来越大的挑战，尤其是极低K介质层中的裂纹等微弱缺陷，往往对比度低、尺寸小，容易在显微图像中漏检。该研究关注倒装芯片互连缺陷检测，试图通过人工智能图像增强技术提升失效分析图像的质量和缺陷可见性。

从技术思路看，该方案的核心是将AI图像增强引入微电子封装失效分析流程，对传统显微成像或失效分析图像进行去噪、对比度增强和特征强化，使裂纹、空洞、界面异常等低对比度缺陷更易被识别。其创新点在于针对先进封装和极低K介质材料的成像难点，利用数据驱动的图像处理方法增强微弱缺陷特征，并结合材料分析、检测设备和封装测试环节的实际需求，提升缺陷检测的灵敏度和判读一致性。公开摘要未披露具体模型结构、训练数据规模以及检测灵敏度、误报率、处理时间等量化指标，但研究目标明确指向降低漏检风险、提高失效分析效率。

在应用层面，该技术可服务于倒装芯片互连检测、微凸点与封装界面失效分析、极低K介质裂纹评估、先进封装研发与良率提升等场景。对于半导体制造和封装测试而言，AI辅助图像增强有望缩短失效分析周期，减少对人工经验的过度依赖，并为高密度、细间距封装结构的可靠性评估提供更有效的图像判据。该研究也体现了材料分析机构、检测设备厂商和封装测试企业协同推进AI在半导体失效分析中落地的趋势。

items.titleZh: 3D集成减少GPU规模扩展的隐含排放影响（imec，VUB）
items.descriptionZh:
imec与布鲁塞尔自由大学（Vrije Universiteit Brussels）研究人员发表了题为《Embodied Emissions of 2.5D and 3D Scaling in Chipletized GPUs for Low-Carbon AI》的研究，关注AI算力扩张背景下高性能GPU的隐含碳排放问题。所谓隐含排放，主要指芯片制造、封装、组装和供应链等非运行阶段产生的碳足迹。随着AI工作负载持续增长，GPU计算资源不断扩展，依赖高性能GPU的超大规模数据中心对气候变化的影响也进一步上升；因此，研究试图建模封装决策如何影响GPU的碳排放表现。

该研究的核心是比较基于芯粒（chiplet）的GPU在2.5D和3D集成缩放路线下的隐含排放。芯粒化设计将大型GPU芯片拆分为多个较小芯粒，再通过先进封装实现高密度互连。2.5D集成通常借助中介层将芯粒并排连接，而3D集成则通过垂直堆叠缩短互连距离，有望提升带宽和能效并改变芯片面积、制造复杂度和材料使用。研究的创新点在于将先进封装方案纳入GPU碳足迹评估，而不仅关注运行能耗，从而为低碳AI硬件设计提供更完整的视角。

根据文章标题和可见摘要，研究结论是3D集成可降低GPU缩放带来的隐含排放影响。不过，当前可见内容未披露具体性能参数、排放数值或2.5D与3D的量化对比数据，需查阅全文获取详细结果。该研究的意义在于为超大规模数据中心、AI加速器和芯粒GPU的封装路线选择提供低碳决策依据，说明先进封装不仅是性能和集成度问题，也应成为AI基础设施碳排放评估的重要维度。

items.title: OpenAI considers rebranding data centers to 'AI compute campuses" as data center backlash intensifies
items.description: OpenAI expects AI to become a major issue in the 2028 presidential election and is preparing a policy and public relations push after the U.S. midterm elections. The company is also promoting the term “AI compute campuses” for its data centers as it seeks to address concerns over electricity demand, water consumption, pollution and rising utility bills
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 7 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter OpenAI is reportedly preparing a major public relations campaign to influence how Americans view artificial intelligence, including a proposal to rename its data centers as “AI Compute Campuses,” Axios reports. The initiative comes ahead of the November 3 U.S. midterm elections and forms a broader effort to influence the debate around AI before the 2028 presidential race. Chris Lehane, OpenAI’s chief global affairs officer, noted that the midterms would be “a bit of a movie trailer for what you’re going to see in 2028.” He expects AI to be a major issue for presidential candidates as the technology raises concerns over its impact on jobs, the economy, and the environment.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe proposed terminology change by OpenAI has been ongoing since August as the company focuses on promoting safeguards for the powerful technology, which Lehane described as “speed limits.” The proposed AI compute campuses is particularly interesting as it comes as opposition to large data centers accelerates across the U.S. Data centers require enormous amounts of electricity and water, with nearby communities raising concerns about noise, air pollution, rising utility bills and limited public consultation. OpenAI hopes to address these concerns through community agreements and a different way of presenting the infrastructure. “Compute campuses better describe the role of the infrastructure we are rebuilding for AI," a company spokesperson separately stated. He added that these projects represent long term investments in computing, energy infrastructure, and skilled jobs.The latest proposal follows similar efforts by other technology companies to improve their relationship with communities hosting their infrastructure. In January, Microsoft announced a community-first approach, promising to cover electricity cost increases associated with its data centers, and invest in local infrastructure and jobs. However, while changing the name may be easier, changing public opinion may bring some headaches. A Redfin report in May found that 47% of Americans surveyed are opposed to having a new data center built in their community. Another report in August detailed how negotiations between developers and local authorities frequently take place behind non-disclosure agreements, leaving residents without access to important project information.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The resistance has also affected actual construction plans. At least 19 Michigan municipalities have already moved to restrict new data center developments after OpenAI and Oracle’s $16 billion Stargate project went ahead with their project in Sanile township despite local opposition. Meanwhile, Amazon abandoned plans for four data centers in northern Virginia last month following community pushback.OpenAI is not alone in trying to reshape the language surrounding AI. President Donald Trump has previously pushed for terminology change, directing Federal agencies and urging AI companies to replace artificial intelligence with ‘super intelligence.’ Trump announced the change in late September arguing that the word "artificial" made the technology sound "fake." His administration subsequently instructed state department employees to use super intelligence or SI in official directives, websites, reports and policy documents. You may like Amazon warns $68 billion in blocked data centers threatens US AI lead AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin quickly blocking new developments OpenAI and Anthropic scramble for smaller data centers as massive gigawatt projects lag Some technology executives have also embraced the terminology. Nvidia CEO Huang has previously referred to data centers as "superintelligence factories" while Elon musk announced plans to rename his AI company SpaceXAI to SpacexSI last month. Meta, meanwhile, established Meta superintelligence labs in 2025, and Microsoft has also assembled a team focused on developing superintelligence. OpenAI’s proposed terminology will now face a more difficult test than simply finding a name as communities will still want answers about the raised issues. Lehane, however, acknowledged that public scrutiny is part of the process saying, “Communities should hold companies responsible and accountable so they really and truly get a transformative benefit from these projects.” Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors

items.titleZh: 随着数据中心反对声浪加剧，OpenAI考虑将数据中心更名为“AI算力园区”
items.descriptionZh:
OpenAI正筹备一场大规模公关行动，试图影响美国公众对人工智能的看法，其中包括将其数据中心更名为“AI Compute Campuses”（AI计算园区/算力园区）。据Axios报道，该行动发生在11月3日美国中期选举之前，并被视为OpenAI在2028年总统竞选前更广泛地塑造AI公共辩论的一部分。OpenAI首席全球事务官Chris Lehane称，中期选举将像2028年大选的“预告片”，随着AI对就业、经济和环境的影响引发担忧，AI预计将成为总统候选人的主要议题。OpenAI自8月以来持续推动这一术语调整，同时强调对强大AI技术设置“限速”式保障措施。

“AI Compute Campuses”这一提法尤其值得注意，因为美国各地对大型数据中心的反对正在加速。数据中心需要大量电力和水资源，周边社区担忧噪音、空气污染、电费上涨以及公众咨询不足。OpenAI希望通过社区协议和不同的基础设施表述方式来回应这些担忧。公司发言人称，“计算园区”更能描述OpenAI为AI重建的基础设施所扮演的角色，这些项目是对计算、能源基础设施和熟练就业岗位的长期投资。换言之，更名并不改变数据中心的物理属性，而是试图把“高耗能设施”的公众叙事转向“长期算力基础设施和社区投资”。

这一提议与其他科技公司改善社区关系的努力类似。微软今年1月宣布“社区优先”方案，承诺承担其数据中心相关的电费上涨，并投资当地基础设施和就业。但改名容易，改变公众意见更难。Redfin 5月调查显示，47%的受访美国人反对在所在社区新建数据中心。8月另一份报告指出，开发商与地方当局的谈判经常在保密协议下进行，居民无法获得重要项目信息。反对情绪已影响实际建设：在OpenAI和Oracle的160亿美元Stargate项目于密歇根州Saline镇推进后，该州至少19个市镇已采取措施限制新数据中心开发；亚马逊上月也因社区反对放弃了北弗吉尼亚四个数据中心计划。

OpenAI并非唯一试图重塑AI相关语言的公司。美国总统特朗普此前推动术语变更，指示联邦机构并敦促AI公司用“super intelligence”（超级智能）替代“artificial intelligence”（人工智能），理由是“artificial”让技术听起来“虚假”。其政府随后指示国务院员工在官方指令、网站、报告和政策文件中使用“super intelligence”或“SI”。科技高管也在采用类似表述：英伟达CEO黄仁勋曾称数据中心为“superintelligence factories”（超级智能工厂）；马斯克宣布计划将其AI公司SpaceXAI更名为SpacexSI；Meta于2025年设立Meta Superintelligence Labs；微软也组建了专注于开发超级智能的团队。对OpenAI而言，提出新术语将面临比取名更艰难的考验，因为社区仍会要求回答电费、水资源、噪音、污染和公众参与等实质问题。Lehane承认公众审查是过程的一部分，并表示社区应当让公司承担责任，确保项目真正带来变革性收益。

从技术与产业影响看，AI数据中心是支撑大模型训练、推理和云AI服务的关键算力基础设施，其能耗、水耗和并网需求会直接影响项目审批、建设进度和算力供给成本。原文未披露具体算力、能耗、PUE等性能参数，但给出的关键对比数据包括：47%的美国受访者反对社区新建数据中心、密歇根至少19个市镇限制开发、Stargate项目投资160亿美元、亚马逊放弃四个数据中心。这些数据表明，AI基础设施扩张正从单纯的技术和资本问题，转变为涉及地方政治、社区利益和公共叙事的综合问题。OpenAI的更名和公关行动能否降低社区阻力、改善AI舆论环境，并进而影响美国AI算力建设和政策辩论，仍有待观察。

items.titleZh: 联合优化接入点可改进模拟布局（UT Austin）
items.descriptionZh:
据 Semiconductor Engineering 报道，德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（UT Austin）的研究人员发表了题为《APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement》的论文，提出一种面向模拟布局自动化的新方法，将器件位置与接入点进行协同优化，并在布局阶段考虑后续布线需求。

在背景上，模拟/混合信号（AMS）电路设计中的版图自动化长期具有挑战性。原因在于布局过程中引入的寄生效应和器件失配会显著影响电路性能；而在版图流程中，布局又处于关键位置，因为它会约束后续布线方案。传统模拟布局往往先确定器件位置，再处理布线和接入点问题，容易导致布线拥塞、寄生增加和反复迭代。因此，如何在布局阶段同时兼顾器件摆放与布线可行性，是提升模拟布局自动化质量的重要问题。

APPlace 的核心创新在于“路由感知的模拟布局”：它不是把器件位置和接入点分开处理，而是联合优化器件摆放位置与器件接入点配置，使布局结果更有利于后续布线。所谓接入点，可理解为后续布线连接到器件的端口或接入位置；这些接入点的选择会直接影响布线路径、线长、拥塞和寄生。通过将接入点纳入布局优化，APPlace 试图在布局阶段就减少布线不可行性或性能退化风险，从而把布线约束前移到布局决策中。

不过，现有新闻片段和论文摘要开头并未披露具体性能参数、工艺节点、面积/线长/寄生改善幅度、运行时间或与基线方法的定量对比数据，因此无法据此报告明确的提升数值。要评估 APPlace 相对传统模拟布局流程的实际效果，需要查阅论文全文中的实验设置和结果。

从影响和应用看，APPlace 面向模拟/混合信号电路、模拟 IP 和 EDA 布局工具。若该方法在完整实验中有效，它有望减少布局到布线的迭代次数，提高模拟版图流程的可预测性，并降低寄生和失配对性能的影响。其技术方向也反映出模拟布局自动化正从“布局后再考虑布线”转向“布局中联合优化器件位置与布线接入”，对寄生敏感、匹配要求高的模拟电路设计尤其具有潜在价值。

items.content: In an announcement on Monday, OpenAI says it will pilot its “Grid Protectors Program” at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, where the company promises to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies, enough to power air conditioners in around 700,000 homes.The announcement comes as opposition to data centers spreads across the US, in response to massive projects that have begun development and construction, frequently with little or no input from local residents. In Utah, residents protested after Box Elder County commissioners signed off on a data center expected to consume more than double the state’s peak electricity demand in 2025, and spread hot air in the desert valley surrounding the data center.Now OpenAI’s approach is to pitch the construction of power plants that feed the electricity required by the new AI data centers it’s building as “a resource that utilities can call on when communities need it most.”Several states like Tennessee, Florida, Oklahoma, Oregon, and others have enacted laws that say they will prevent AI companies from passing energy costs on to residents, in addition to moratoriums and other restrictions. This is besides the environmental impacts, as a recent study by the Houston Advanced Research Center (HARC) said that powering proposed Texas data center projects could undo decades of air quality gains over just five years.RelatedAnthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boomWho’s afraid of the big, bad GPU?Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your deskOpenAI, which has switched to calling its AI data centers “compute campuses” in an effort to separate from their poor public reputation, claims it helps reduce costs for customers by operating year-round:“Electricity demand also rises and falls with the seasons, with different regions facing their biggest peaks at different times,” OpenAI’s announcement says. “Our compute campuses need power year-round. With the right agreements, that steady demand can help spread the grid’s fixed costs across more electricity sales, while flexibility lets us reduce demand when the system is busiest.”OpenAI says it’s going to continue working with policymakers and utility services to make “arrangements for our future campus to reduce electricity demand when the grid is under strain.” Along with its data center in Georgia, OpenAI is also partnering with Oracle and SoftBank to build its “Stargate” data centers across the US, including in Shackelford County, Texas; Doña Ana County, New Mexico; and Milam County, Texas.

items.titleZh: OpenAI 提议用数据中心发电厂来保护周边地区
items.descriptionZh:
OpenAI周一宣布，将在佐治亚州埃芬汉县一座即将建设的数据中心试点“电网保护者计划”（Grid Protectors Program）。公司承诺，在极端天气或紧急情况下可释放最多1000兆瓦电力，足以为约70万户家庭的空调供电。这一公告发布之际，美国各地对数据中心的反对情绪正在蔓延：许多大型项目在开发建设阶段往往很少或没有征求当地居民意见。在犹他州，博克斯埃尔德县委员批准了一个数据中心项目后引发居民抗议；该数据中心预计耗电量将超过该州2025年峰值电力需求的两倍，并向数据中心周围的沙漠谷地排放热空气。OpenAI的做法是把为新建AI数据中心供电的发电厂定位为“公用事业在社区最需要时可以调用的资源”。田纳西、佛罗里达、俄克拉何马、俄勒冈等多个州已颁布法律，表示将防止AI公司把能源成本转嫁给居民，并出台暂停令和其他限制。环境方面，休斯顿高级研究中心（HARC）近期研究称，为得克萨斯州拟议数据中心项目供电，可能仅用五年就抵消数十年的空气质量改善。

从技术机制看，该计划的核心不是新的芯片技术，而是把AI数据中心及其配套电源改造成电网的“灵活资源”：一方面，数据中心全年稳定用电，可通过长期协议帮助公用事业把电网固定成本分摊到更多售电量上；另一方面，在电网最繁忙或出现极端天气、紧急事件时，通过需求响应和可调度电源削减数据中心负荷或向电网释放电力，从而缓解供电压力。OpenAI称，电力需求随季节起伏，不同地区峰值出现时间不同，而“计算园区”需要全年供电；在合适协议下，这种稳定需求可降低客户成本，灵活性则允许公司在系统最繁忙时减少需求。公司还表示将继续与政策制定者和公用事业合作，为未来园区安排在电网承压时减少电力需求。为改善公众形象，OpenAI已将其AI数据中心改称为“计算园区”（compute campuses），以与数据中心较差的社会声誉保持距离。

性能与对比数据方面，1000兆瓦的释放能力相当于约70万户家庭空调负荷；而犹他州博克斯埃尔德县获批项目的预计耗电量超过该州2025年峰值需求的两倍，显示出大型数据中心对局部电网的巨大压力。HARC研究则提示，得州拟议数据中心项目可能带来显著空气质量倒退。多州立法和暂停令表明，数据中心新增电力成本由谁承担、环境外部性如何控制，已成为AI基础设施扩张的关键政策问题。该计划的影响和应用场景包括：在极端天气、电网高峰和紧急事件中提供可调用容量；通过需求响应协议让数据中心参与电网调节；以全年稳定负荷帮助分摊电网固定成本；并可能复制到OpenAI与Oracle、SoftBank合作建设的“星际之门”（Stargate）数据中心项目中，包括得克萨斯州沙克尔福德县、新墨西哥州多尼亚安娜县和得克萨斯州米拉姆县。不过，该模式也面临争议：配套建设发电厂可能带来排放和社区影响，批评者可能质疑其是否真正降低居民负担，而非以公关方式缓解数据中心扩张阻力。

items.title: Putin demands Russian data centers supply capacity to the state in wake of Ukraine drone attacks
items.description: President Putin has told non-state Russian data centers that they must set aside 10% of their total capacity for use by the country's own IT infrastructure.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Owners of non-state data centers in Russia have been told to hold back 10% of their capacity, ready to aid the country's state-owned IT infrastructure should the need arise. That's the message from President Vladimir Putin, with the aim of quickly unlocking additional data center compute capacity in the future if it becomes needed by the state, reports Reuters.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThis comes as Russian data centers have become targets for Ukrainian drone attacks in recent weeks, causing huge amounts of damage and affecting state-owned internet services. In early October, drones struck Russia's largest data center in what was the second such attack in as many days. The huge 63-megawatt facility was so badly damaged that multiple modules had to be removed from service completely. At the time, users reported problems with Yandex Mail, Disk, Documents, Pay, and Market despite Yandex claiming that key services remained up and running. Two weeks later, Russia's finance ministry's data center was damaged after Ukrainian drones targeted the facility. It was reportedly home to Russia's tax databases as well as other state registry data.Now, Putin has told the Digital Development Ministry to inventory all available data center capacity and floor space at privately owned facilities throughout the country. A new government commission will be given the power to order the release of reserved data center capacity. Once ordered to do so, third-party data center owners will have 24 hours to comply. The temporary use of data centers located outside Russia has also been mooted, pending the approval of Russia's Federal Security Service. (FSB)Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: It isn't just drones that have been targeting Russian data centers. On the same day that news broke of the country's plan to siphon data center capacity from third parties, the Russian Federal State Statistics Service admitted that its servers were hit by cyberattacks that saw 23TB of data stolen. It's reported that the haul includes new data on Russian wartime losses marked “for official use only.”Data centers have become a target for Russia, too. It bombed Ukrainian facilities in September of this year, resulting in the loss of internet connectivity for 100,000 households. At the time, a government official noted that Ukraine's internet network is highly decentralized before admitting that users should expect local disruptions to service. items.titleZh: 普京要求俄数据中心在乌克兰无人机袭击后向国家提供算力
items.descriptionZh:
俄罗斯政府正要求非国有数据中心预留10%的算力容量，以便在国家需要时快速支援国有IT基础设施。路透社称，这一要求由总统普京提出，目标是未来在国有系统需要时能够迅速释放额外数据中心算力。普京已指示数字发展部盘点全国私有数据中心的可用算力容量和机房空间；新成立的政府委员会将有权下令释放被预留的数据中心容量，第三方数据中心所有者收到命令后须在24小时内执行。政府还提出可临时使用位于俄罗斯境外的数据中心，但需获得俄联邦安全局（FSB）批准。

这一举措的背景是，俄罗斯数据中心近几周成为乌克兰无人机袭击目标，造成严重破坏并影响国有互联网服务。10月初，无人机袭击了俄罗斯最大数据中心，这是两天内第二次此类攻击。该63兆瓦设施受损严重，多个模块被迫完全退出服务；当时用户报告Yandex Mail、Disk、Documents、Pay和Market出现问题，尽管Yandex称关键服务仍运行。两周后，俄财政部数据中心遭乌克兰无人机袭击受损，据报道该设施存放俄罗斯税务数据库及其他国家登记数据。与此同时，俄联邦国家统计局承认其服务器遭网络攻击，23TB数据被盗，据称包括标注“仅供官方使用”的俄罗斯战时损失新数据。

从机制上看，这不是芯片或冷却层面的技术突破，而是国家层面的数据中心容量预留与应急调度机制：通过全面盘点私有设施容量、强制预留10%算力、赋予政府委员会释放权限、设定24小时合规时限，并保留经FSB审批使用境外设施的可能性，形成一套快速征用和切换的应急体系。其核心作用是提升国家IT基础设施在无人机打击、网络攻击和战时压力下的韧性，保障税务、登记、邮件、支付等关键服务。性能参数方面，新闻披露的关键数据包括10%的强制预留比例、63兆瓦大型数据中心受损、多个模块停服、23TB数据被盗，以及俄罗斯此前攻击乌克兰数据中心导致10万户家庭断网。技术影响上，该政策可能压缩商业数据中心的可用容量和云服务弹性，但在应急场景下可为国家关键系统提供快速算力支援；应用场景主要覆盖国有互联网服务、税务和登记数据库、支付与邮件等公共服务，以及战时和重大网络攻击后的恢复保障。

items.title: AI model gets a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled directly into its weights, then runs DOOM on it
items.description: Qwenputer is an experimental blend of the stock Qwen 3.5 4B LLM with a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled and inserted directly into its weights.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AI engineer Divyansh Agrawal has revealed the Qwenputer. Described in its most basic terms, Qwenputer is an experimental blend of the stock Qwen 3.5 4B AI LLM with a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled and inserted directly into its weights. In use, Qwenputer can run processor arithmetic operations – or even run C and MicroPython code on its built-in CPU, eschewing any external runtime or tool use. Moreover, it can run Doom, albeit very slowly. You can see the Qwenputer running Doom on its RISC-V CPU by expanding the tweet below.QWenputer by @divagr1925 is so cool! but... can it run DOOM? Ofc yes! E1M1 on the RISC-V CPU compiled into Qwen3.5-4B weights. will opensource too https://t.co/hEa46rD6CJOctober 29, 2026The implementation of Qwenputer raises some interesting concepts and solutions. For example, the developer used Qwen’s Gated DeltaNet (GND) state as RAM, which Agrawal reckons is “a pretty neat trick.” They admit that using these ‘fast weights’ as RAM isn’t an original concept, but modifying Qwen 3.5 this way does seem to be a first.Unlike traditional LLM creation, adding a ‘CPU’ doesn’t involve training. This RISC-V CPU implementation “is 11 transformer layers in front of Qwen's own, and none of their weights are learned: a compiler computes every one,” it is explained. Agrawal boasts that Qwenputer’s built-in CPU “passes the official riscv-tests, its programs match qemu, and it has run 18 million instructions free-running without a single error.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The developer stresses that Qwen makes use of this ‘CPU’ to send instructions and read them back with no external tool or runtime calls. In practice, it works as intended. Use of the CPU inside Qwenputer provides exact calculations, overcoming the arithmetic weaknesses of many LLMs. Moreover, users can run code on the CPU inside the LLM, with C and MicroPython compatibility.Not content with wedging a CPU into an LLM, Agrawal decided to also give it a filesystem. They describe this extension of the model as relatively trivial, since RAM is already in place. Indeed, the filesystem storage also uses the DeltaNet state. There are 1,024 slots holding up to 512 files. Moreover, this storage is persistent if you save the state at the end of a conversation with the LLM. Thus, Agrawal recommends a workstation with 24GB of VRAM or more for testing Qwenputer in its current version. Efforts are being made to streamline coding in Qwenputer, as well as make it run faster. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Divyansh Agrawal) (Image credit: Divyansh Agrawal) (Image credit: Divyansh Agrawal) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original The project is experimental. One gets the impression that Agrawal built Qwenputer primarily as an experiment to explore what is possible, rather than to solve a specific problem. Nevertheless, the creation of this custom LLM raises some interesting concepts and makes the mind wander regarding potential practical applications.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn addition to the above-linked blog, you can learn more about Qwenputer from its MIT-licensed code on GitHub. items.titleZh: AI 模型将一个 32 位 RISC-V CPU 直接编译进其权重，然后在其上运行《毁灭战士》
items.descriptionZh:
AI工程师Divyansh Agrawal公开了实验性项目Qwenputer：它将一个32位RISC-V CPU编译并直接插入Qwen 3.5 4B大语言模型的权重中，使模型本身能够执行处理器算术运算，甚至运行C和MicroPython代码，而无需依赖外部运行时或工具调用。该项目还能运行《Doom》，但速度非常慢；演示中E1M1关卡是在编译进Qwen3.5-4B权重的RISC-V CPU上运行的。

Qwenputer的核心创新在于把CPU“嵌入”LLM内部，而不是通过外部工具接口调用计算资源。Agrawal利用Qwen的Gated DeltaNet状态作为RAM，也就是所谓“快速权重”作为内存。他承认把快速权重用作RAM并非原创概念，但以这种方式修改Qwen 3.5似乎尚属首次。与通常的LLM构建方式不同，加入这个“CPU”不涉及训练：该RISC-V CPU实现是位于Qwen原有层之前的11个Transformer层，且这些层的权重都不是学习得到的，而是由编译器计算每一个权重。Agrawal称，内置CPU通过了官方riscv-tests，其程序运行结果与QEMU一致，并且曾自由运行1800万条指令而没有出现一次错误。模型利用这个CPU发送指令并读回结果，不需要外部工具或运行时调用。

在实际效果上，内置CPU为Qwenputer提供了精确计算能力，有助于克服许多LLM在算术上的弱点；用户还可以在LLM内部的CPU上运行代码，并兼容C和MicroPython。Agrawal还进一步为模型增加了文件系统。由于RAM已经就位，这一扩展相对简单；文件系统存储同样使用DeltaNet状态，共有1024个槽位，最多可容纳512个文件。如果在对话结束时保存状态，这些存储内容可以持久保留。

代价是资源占用显著增加：Qwenputer使底层Qwen 3.5 4B模型的大小几乎翻倍，达到近19GB，因此Agrawal建议使用至少24GB显存的 workstation 来测试当前版本。团队也在努力简化Qwenputer中的编码流程并提升运行速度。总体而言，该项目仍属实验性质，更多是探索LLM与CPU深度融合的可能性，而非解决某一具体问题。但它展示了无需外部工具即可在模型内部执行精确计算和代码、并维护持久文件系统的思路，对理解LLM算术可靠性、工具调用替代方案以及模型内部状态利用具有一定启发意义。Qwenputer代码以MIT许可证发布在GitHub，模型也可从Hugging Face获取。

items.title: SpaceX loses bid to dismiss lawsuit over xAI data center pollution
items.description: SpaceX loses latest legal fight over xAI's gas-powered data centers in Mississippi — court rejects arguments that mobile turbines are exempt from air permits
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter SpaceX has suffered a setback after losing in a lawsuit aimed at stopping the Clean Air Act requirements on the turbines powering xAI’s Colossus 2 data center in Southaven, Mississippi. According to a report by CNBC, a judge rejected the company’s motion to dismiss the case on Friday, October 30, allowing the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP) to proceed, rejecting xAI’s argument that its turbines fall under the ‘mobile sources’ category that exempts it from air permitting requirements.The case, brought in April 2026 by the NAACP and represented by the Southern Environmental Law Center (SELC) alongside Earthjustice, targets xAI’s operation of a gas-fired power plant to supply electricity to its facility in the Greater Memphis area. SpaceX owns and operates xAI, implicating Elon Musk's wider aerospace and technology company.According to court documents, NACCP accuses xAI and its subsidiary, MZX Tech, of installing 27 gas turbines in Southaven last year without obtaining the required permits. The applicants also argued that the company’s equipment has been polluting the environment through nitrogen oxide emissions and fine particulate matter, which can contribute to breath-related hazards to residents. The SELC particularly says the plant could emit over 5,00 tons of nitrogen oxides, 400 tons of fine particulate matter, and 47 tons of formaldehyde — a cancer-causing chemical — annually.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The judge also rejected xAI’s attempted classification of the turbines as mobile equipment, holding that the company did not qualify for exemptions under applicable regulations and that the turbines were not exempt from Clean Air Act permitting requirements. Just two weeks earlier, SpaceX suffered another setback after the same court rejected a separate Department of Justice lawsuit that argued against the case proceeding.“This decision is another important victory in our effort to hold xAI accountable. The courts have repeatedly rejected attempts by xAI and the DOJ to dismiss the NAACP’s Clean Air Act case, affirming our right to pursue justice for communities impacted by pollution. Our position has been clear: xAI cannot operate gas turbines without the required permits. Now that the motion to dismiss has been denied, we look forward to continuing to defend our position in court,” Abre’ Conner, NAACP Director of Environmental and Climate Justice, said. SpaceX is yet to comment on the ruling. The Memphis facility plans for about 860,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs across four Colossus buildings —but it could be more — with Musk stating, “There will be a total of around 1.2M Blackwells at Colossus 2 by end of year”Elon Musk just gave a massive update on Colossus 2 in Memphis, and the scale of what's being built is absolutely insane Two buildings already packed with GB300s, two more are coming online within weeks, and it is heading toward roughly 860,000 NVIDIA GB300s Here's the breakdown: • Macroharder: 220,000 GB300s, 800-gig NICs, configured for training • Minihard: 220,000 GB300s, same training configuration • Gun Range: 220,000 GB300s, tracking to be operational by the END OF NOVEMBER • Spam: ~200,000 GB300s, configured for inference, targeting DECEMBER That's roughly 860,000 GB300s across these four buildings Spam is designed for inference, which needs much simpler networking and less than HALF the fiber of the training buildings. And yes, the building once housed Hormel products Elon personally walked the entire Colossus 2 site around midnight and again the next morning to check progress Building by building, SpaceXSI is assembling SI compute at a speed no one else on Earth can matchOctober 31, 2026In August, the company stated that it would remove its unpermitted turbine generators and replace them with a larger permitted power plant — but that could take at least a year. The latest setback adds to a string of lawsuits surrounding the gas-powered infrastructure used to power xAI’s data centers. In June, the DOJ had asked the court to dismiss the NACCP’s lawsuit, arguing that Colossus 2 supports crucial national security operations. That request was, however, rejected. items.titleZh: SpaceX未能驳回就xAI数据中心污染提起的诉讼
items.descriptionZh:
SpaceX在围绕xAI“Colossus 2”数据中心供电设施的法律战中遭遇挫折。据CNBC报道，法官于10月30日驳回SpaceX要求驳回诉讼的动议，允许美国全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）继续推进其依据《清洁空气法》提起的诉讼。案件焦点是xAI在密西西比州Southaven为孟菲斯地区数据中心运营燃气发电设施。NAACP及其代理律师——南方环境法律中心（SELC）和Earthjustice——于2026年4月起诉，指控xAI及其子公司MZX Tech去年在Southaven安装27台燃气轮机但未取得所需空气排放许可，并称这些设备排放氮氧化物和细颗粒物，可能危害居民呼吸健康。SELC称，该电厂每年可能排放超过500吨氮氧化物、400吨细颗粒物以及47吨可致癌的甲醛。xAI曾主张这些涡轮机属于可豁免空气许可要求的“移动源”，但法官拒绝这一分类，认定其不符合适用法规下的豁免条件，涡轮机不能免于《清洁空气法》的许可要求。NAACP环境与气候正义主任Abre’ Conner称，这是追究xAI责任的又一重要胜利，法院已多次拒绝xAI和美国司法部试图驳回案件的做法，并强调xAI不能在缺少许可的情况下运行燃气轮机。SpaceX尚未对裁决置评。

这起诉讼的背景是AI数据中心对电力的巨大需求。Colossus 2位于孟菲斯，7月已安装59台天然气涡轮机，立即引发居民对排放和社区影响的担忧。该设施计划在四栋建筑中部署约86万块Nvidia GB300 GPU，甚至可能更多；马斯克称到年底Colossus 2将有约120万块Blackwell系列GPU。具体而言，“Macroharder”和“Minihard”各配置22万块GB300，使用800G网卡，面向训练；“Gun Range”配置22万块GB300，目标11月底投入运行；“Spam”约20万块GB300，面向推理，目标12月上线。四栋建筑合计约86万块GB300。推理集群“Spam”所需网络更简单，光纤用量不到训练建筑的一半。报道还称，马斯克曾在午夜和次日早晨亲自巡视整个Colossus 2现场，SpaceX相关团队正以极快速度组装算力设施。

从技术上看，Colossus 2体现了两类AI负载的差异化设计：训练集群需要高带宽、低延迟网络和大量光纤连接，以支撑大规模并行训练；推理集群则可采用更简化的网络架构，降低成本和部署复杂度。GB300是Nvidia新一代Blackwell架构GPU，单机性能和显存能力提升，使单集群规模可达数十万块GPU。但如此规模的算力集群也带来巨大供电压力，xAI选择自建燃气发电设施以快速上线，却因此触发清洁空气许可争议。此次判决的核心法律意义在于，法院不接受将燃气轮机简单归类为“移动源”来规避固定源排放许可，这将对AI数据中心自备电厂和快速部署模式形成合规约束。

此前，同一法院已在两周前驳回美国司法部试图阻止案件推进的另一项诉讼；6月司法部曾以Colossus 2支持关键国家安全行动为由请求驳回NAACP诉讼，但未获支持。8月，公司表示将移除未获许可的涡轮发电机，并替换为规模更大的获许可电厂，但这可能需要至少一年。近期SpaceX还开始内部制造涡轮叶片，以加快xAI数据中心发电机的生产。总体来看，此案不仅关乎Colossus 2的供电安排，也涉及AI基础设施扩张中算力、电力、环境合规与社区健康之间的张力；若诉讼持续推进，可能影响数据中心上线节奏，并为类似“自备燃气电厂+AI集群”模式树立监管先例。

history.titleZh: AI图像增强提升倒装芯片互连缺陷检测（MCL、PVA TePla、ASE）
history.descriptionZh:
研究人员来自奥地利莱奥本材料中心（Materials Center Leoben）、PVA TePla和日月光半导体（ASE），合作发表了题为《基于AI的图像增强改善微电子封装互连缺陷检测》的论文。随着现代半导体器件持续小型化、结构复杂化，先进封装中的互连密度不断提高，传统失效分析（FA）方法在缺陷定位和判读上面临越来越大的挑战，尤其是极低K介质层中的裂纹等微弱缺陷，往往对比度低、尺寸小，容易在显微图像中漏检。该研究关注倒装芯片互连缺陷检测，试图通过人工智能图像增强技术提升失效分析图像的质量和缺陷可见性。

从技术思路看，该方案的核心是将AI图像增强引入微电子封装失效分析流程，对传统显微成像或失效分析图像进行去噪、对比度增强和特征强化，使裂纹、空洞、界面异常等低对比度缺陷更易被识别。其创新点在于针对先进封装和极低K介质材料的成像难点，利用数据驱动的图像处理方法增强微弱缺陷特征，并结合材料分析、检测设备和封装测试环节的实际需求，提升缺陷检测的灵敏度和判读一致性。公开摘要未披露具体模型结构、训练数据规模以及检测灵敏度、误报率、处理时间等量化指标，但研究目标明确指向降低漏检风险、提高失效分析效率。

在应用层面，该技术可服务于倒装芯片互连检测、微凸点与封装界面失效分析、极低K介质裂纹评估、先进封装研发与良率提升等场景。对于半导体制造和封装测试而言，AI辅助图像增强有望缩短失效分析周期，减少对人工经验的过度依赖，并为高密度、细间距封装结构的可靠性评估提供更有效的图像判据。该研究也体现了材料分析机构、检测设备厂商和封装测试企业协同推进AI在半导体失效分析中落地的趋势。

history.titleZh: 3D集成减少GPU规模扩展的隐含排放影响（imec，VUB）
history.descriptionZh:
imec与布鲁塞尔自由大学（Vrije Universiteit Brussels）研究人员发表了题为《Embodied Emissions of 2.5D and 3D Scaling in Chipletized GPUs for Low-Carbon AI》的研究，关注AI算力扩张背景下高性能GPU的隐含碳排放问题。所谓隐含排放，主要指芯片制造、封装、组装和供应链等非运行阶段产生的碳足迹。随着AI工作负载持续增长，GPU计算资源不断扩展，依赖高性能GPU的超大规模数据中心对气候变化的影响也进一步上升；因此，研究试图建模封装决策如何影响GPU的碳排放表现。

该研究的核心是比较基于芯粒（chiplet）的GPU在2.5D和3D集成缩放路线下的隐含排放。芯粒化设计将大型GPU芯片拆分为多个较小芯粒，再通过先进封装实现高密度互连。2.5D集成通常借助中介层将芯粒并排连接，而3D集成则通过垂直堆叠缩短互连距离，有望提升带宽和能效并改变芯片面积、制造复杂度和材料使用。研究的创新点在于将先进封装方案纳入GPU碳足迹评估，而不仅关注运行能耗，从而为低碳AI硬件设计提供更完整的视角。

根据文章标题和可见摘要，研究结论是3D集成可降低GPU缩放带来的隐含排放影响。不过，当前可见内容未披露具体性能参数、排放数值或2.5D与3D的量化对比数据，需查阅全文获取详细结果。该研究的意义在于为超大规模数据中心、AI加速器和芯粒GPU的封装路线选择提供低碳决策依据，说明先进封装不仅是性能和集成度问题，也应成为AI基础设施碳排放评估的重要维度。

history.title: OpenAI considers rebranding data centers to 'AI compute campuses" as data center backlash intensifies
history.description: OpenAI expects AI to become a major issue in the 2028 presidential election and is preparing a policy and public relations push after the U.S. midterm elections. The company is also promoting the term “AI compute campuses” for its data centers as it seeks to address concerns over electricity demand, water consumption, pollution and rising utility bills
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 7 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter OpenAI is reportedly preparing a major public relations campaign to influence how Americans view artificial intelligence, including a proposal to rename its data centers as “AI Compute Campuses,” Axios reports. The initiative comes ahead of the November 3 U.S. midterm elections and forms a broader effort to influence the debate around AI before the 2028 presidential race. Chris Lehane, OpenAI’s chief global affairs officer, noted that the midterms would be “a bit of a movie trailer for what you’re going to see in 2028.” He expects AI to be a major issue for presidential candidates as the technology raises concerns over its impact on jobs, the economy, and the environment.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe proposed terminology change by OpenAI has been ongoing since August as the company focuses on promoting safeguards for the powerful technology, which Lehane described as “speed limits.” The proposed AI compute campuses is particularly interesting as it comes as opposition to large data centers accelerates across the U.S. Data centers require enormous amounts of electricity and water, with nearby communities raising concerns about noise, air pollution, rising utility bills and limited public consultation. OpenAI hopes to address these concerns through community agreements and a different way of presenting the infrastructure. “Compute campuses better describe the role of the infrastructure we are rebuilding for AI," a company spokesperson separately stated. He added that these projects represent long term investments in computing, energy infrastructure, and skilled jobs.The latest proposal follows similar efforts by other technology companies to improve their relationship with communities hosting their infrastructure. In January, Microsoft announced a community-first approach, promising to cover electricity cost increases associated with its data centers, and invest in local infrastructure and jobs. However, while changing the name may be easier, changing public opinion may bring some headaches. A Redfin report in May found that 47% of Americans surveyed are opposed to having a new data center built in their community. Another report in August detailed how negotiations between developers and local authorities frequently take place behind non-disclosure agreements, leaving residents without access to important project information.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The resistance has also affected actual construction plans. At least 19 Michigan municipalities have already moved to restrict new data center developments after OpenAI and Oracle’s $16 billion Stargate project went ahead with their project in Sanile township despite local opposition. Meanwhile, Amazon abandoned plans for four data centers in northern Virginia last month following community pushback.OpenAI is not alone in trying to reshape the language surrounding AI. President Donald Trump has previously pushed for terminology change, directing Federal agencies and urging AI companies to replace artificial intelligence with ‘super intelligence.’ Trump announced the change in late September arguing that the word "artificial" made the technology sound "fake." His administration subsequently instructed state department employees to use super intelligence or SI in official directives, websites, reports and policy documents. You may like Amazon warns $68 billion in blocked data centers threatens US AI lead AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin quickly blocking new developments OpenAI and Anthropic scramble for smaller data centers as massive gigawatt projects lag Some technology executives have also embraced the terminology. Nvidia CEO Huang has previously referred to data centers as "superintelligence factories" while Elon musk announced plans to rename his AI company SpaceXAI to SpacexSI last month. Meta, meanwhile, established Meta superintelligence labs in 2025, and Microsoft has also assembled a team focused on developing superintelligence. OpenAI’s proposed terminology will now face a more difficult test than simply finding a name as communities will still want answers about the raised issues. history.titleZh: 随着数据中心反对声浪加剧，OpenAI考虑将数据中心更名为“AI算力园区”
history.descriptionZh:
OpenAI正筹备一场大规模公关行动，试图影响美国公众对人工智能的看法，其中包括将其数据中心更名为“AI Compute Campuses”（AI计算园区/算力园区）。据Axios报道，该行动发生在11月3日美国中期选举之前，并被视为OpenAI在2028年总统竞选前更广泛地塑造AI公共辩论的一部分。OpenAI首席全球事务官Chris Lehane称，中期选举将像2028年大选的“预告片”，随着AI对就业、经济和环境的影响引发担忧，AI预计将成为总统候选人的主要议题。OpenAI自8月以来持续推动这一术语调整，同时强调对强大AI技术设置“限速”式保障措施。

“AI Compute Campuses”这一提法尤其值得注意，因为美国各地对大型数据中心的反对正在加速。数据中心需要大量电力和水资源，周边社区担忧噪音、空气污染、电费上涨以及公众咨询不足。OpenAI希望通过社区协议和不同的基础设施表述方式来回应这些担忧。公司发言人称，“计算园区”更能描述OpenAI为AI重建的基础设施所扮演的角色，这些项目是对计算、能源基础设施和熟练就业岗位的长期投资。换言之，更名并不改变数据中心的物理属性，而是试图把“高耗能设施”的公众叙事转向“长期算力基础设施和社区投资”。

这一提议与其他科技公司改善社区关系的努力类似。微软今年1月宣布“社区优先”方案，承诺承担其数据中心相关的电费上涨，并投资当地基础设施和就业。但改名容易，改变公众意见更难。Redfin 5月调查显示，47%的受访美国人反对在所在社区新建数据中心。8月另一份报告指出，开发商与地方当局的谈判经常在保密协议下进行，居民无法获得重要项目信息。反对情绪已影响实际建设：在OpenAI和Oracle的160亿美元Stargate项目于密歇根州Saline镇推进后，该州至少19个市镇已采取措施限制新数据中心开发；亚马逊上月也因社区反对放弃了北弗吉尼亚四个数据中心计划。

OpenAI并非唯一试图重塑AI相关语言的公司。美国总统特朗普此前推动术语变更，指示联邦机构并敦促AI公司用“super intelligence”（超级智能）替代“artificial intelligence”（人工智能），理由是“artificial”让技术听起来“虚假”。其政府随后指示国务院员工在官方指令、网站、报告和政策文件中使用“super intelligence”或“SI”。科技高管也在采用类似表述：英伟达CEO黄仁勋曾称数据中心为“superintelligence factories”（超级智能工厂）；马斯克宣布计划将其AI公司SpaceXAI更名为SpacexSI；Meta于2025年设立Meta Superintelligence Labs；微软也组建了专注于开发超级智能的团队。对OpenAI而言，提出新术语将面临比取名更艰难的考验，因为社区仍会要求回答电费、水资源、噪音、污染和公众参与等实质问题。Lehane承认公众审查是过程的一部分，并表示社区应当让公司承担责任，确保项目真正带来变革性收益。

从技术与产业影响看，AI数据中心是支撑大模型训练、推理和云AI服务的关键算力基础设施，其能耗、水耗和并网需求会直接影响项目审批、建设进度和算力供给成本。原文未披露具体算力、能耗、PUE等性能参数，但给出的关键对比数据包括：47%的美国受访者反对社区新建数据中心、密歇根至少19个市镇限制开发、Stargate项目投资160亿美元、亚马逊放弃四个数据中心。这些数据表明，AI基础设施扩张正从单纯的技术和资本问题，转变为涉及地方政治、社区利益和公共叙事的综合问题。OpenAI的更名和公关行动能否降低社区阻力、改善AI舆论环境，并进而影响美国AI算力建设和政策辩论，仍有待观察。

history.titleZh: 联合优化接入点可改进模拟布局（UT Austin）
history.descriptionZh:
据 Semiconductor Engineering 报道，德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（UT Austin）的研究人员发表了题为《APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement》的论文，提出一种面向模拟布局自动化的新方法，将器件位置与接入点进行协同优化，并在布局阶段考虑后续布线需求。

在背景上，模拟/混合信号（AMS）电路设计中的版图自动化长期具有挑战性。原因在于布局过程中引入的寄生效应和器件失配会显著影响电路性能；而在版图流程中，布局又处于关键位置，因为它会约束后续布线方案。传统模拟布局往往先确定器件位置，再处理布线和接入点问题，容易导致布线拥塞、寄生增加和反复迭代。因此，如何在布局阶段同时兼顾器件摆放与布线可行性，是提升模拟布局自动化质量的重要问题。

APPlace 的核心创新在于“路由感知的模拟布局”：它不是把器件位置和接入点分开处理，而是联合优化器件摆放位置与器件接入点配置，使布局结果更有利于后续布线。所谓接入点，可理解为后续布线连接到器件的端口或接入位置；这些接入点的选择会直接影响布线路径、线长、拥塞和寄生。通过将接入点纳入布局优化，APPlace 试图在布局阶段就减少布线不可行性或性能退化风险，从而把布线约束前移到布局决策中。

不过，现有新闻片段和论文摘要开头并未披露具体性能参数、工艺节点、面积/线长/寄生改善幅度、运行时间或与基线方法的定量对比数据，因此无法据此报告明确的提升数值。要评估 APPlace 相对传统模拟布局流程的实际效果，需要查阅论文全文中的实验设置和结果。

从影响和应用看，APPlace 面向模拟/混合信号电路、模拟 IP 和 EDA 布局工具。若该方法在完整实验中有效，它有望减少布局到布线的迭代次数，提高模拟版图流程的可预测性，并降低寄生和失配对性能的影响。其技术方向也反映出模拟布局自动化正从“布局后再考虑布线”转向“布局中联合优化器件位置与布线接入”，对寄生敏感、匹配要求高的模拟电路设计尤其具有潜在价值。

history.content: In an announcement on Monday, OpenAI says it will pilot its “Grid Protectors Program” at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, where the company promises to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies, enough to power air conditioners in around 700,000 homes.The announcement comes as opposition to data centers spreads across the US, in response to massive projects that have begun development and construction, frequently with little or no input from local residents. In Utah, residents protested after Box Elder County commissioners signed off on a data center expected to consume more than double the state’s peak electricity demand in 2025, and spread hot air in the desert valley surrounding the data center.Now OpenAI’s approach is to pitch the construction of power plants that feed the electricity required by the new AI data centers it’s building as “a resource that utilities can call on when communities need it most.”Several states like Tennessee, Florida, Oklahoma, Oregon, and others have enacted laws that say they will prevent AI companies from passing energy costs on to residents, in addition to moratoriums and other restrictions. This is besides the environmental impacts, as a recent study by the Houston Advanced Research Center (HARC) said that powering proposed Texas data center projects could undo decades of air quality gains over just five years.RelatedAnthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boomWho’s afraid of the big, bad GPU?Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your deskOpenAI, which has switched to calling its AI data centers “compute campuses” in an effort to separate from their poor public reputation, claims it helps reduce costs for customers by operating year-round:“Electricity demand also rises and falls with the seasons, with different regions facing their biggest peaks at different times,” OpenAI’s announcement says. “Our compute campuses need power year-round. With the right agreements, that steady demand can help spread the grid’s fixed costs across more electricity sales, while flexibility lets us reduce demand when the system is busiest.”OpenAI says it’s going to continue working with policymakers and utility services to make “arrangements for our future campus to reduce electricity demand when the grid is under strain.” Along with its data center in Georgia, OpenAI is also partnering with Oracle and SoftBank to build its “Stargate” data centers across the US, including in Shackelford County, Texas; Doña Ana County, New Mexico; and Milam County, Texas.

history.titleZh: OpenAI 提议用数据中心发电厂来保护周边地区
history.descriptionZh:
OpenAI周一宣布，将在佐治亚州埃芬汉县一座即将建设的数据中心试点“电网保护者计划”（Grid Protectors Program）。公司承诺，在极端天气或紧急情况下可释放最多1000兆瓦电力，足以为约70万户家庭的空调供电。这一公告发布之际，美国各地对数据中心的反对情绪正在蔓延：许多大型项目在开发建设阶段往往很少或没有征求当地居民意见。在犹他州，博克斯埃尔德县委员批准了一个数据中心项目后引发居民抗议；该数据中心预计耗电量将超过该州2025年峰值电力需求的两倍，并向数据中心周围的沙漠谷地排放热空气。OpenAI的做法是把为新建AI数据中心供电的发电厂定位为“公用事业在社区最需要时可以调用的资源”。田纳西、佛罗里达、俄克拉何马、俄勒冈等多个州已颁布法律，表示将防止AI公司把能源成本转嫁给居民，并出台暂停令和其他限制。环境方面，休斯顿高级研究中心（HARC）近期研究称，为得克萨斯州拟议数据中心项目供电，可能仅用五年就抵消数十年的空气质量改善。

从技术机制看，该计划的核心不是新的芯片技术，而是把AI数据中心及其配套电源改造成电网的“灵活资源”：一方面，数据中心全年稳定用电，可通过长期协议帮助公用事业把电网固定成本分摊到更多售电量上；另一方面，在电网最繁忙或出现极端天气、紧急事件时，通过需求响应和可调度电源削减数据中心负荷或向电网释放电力，从而缓解供电压力。OpenAI称，电力需求随季节起伏，不同地区峰值出现时间不同，而“计算园区”需要全年供电；在合适协议下，这种稳定需求可降低客户成本，灵活性则允许公司在系统最繁忙时减少需求。公司还表示将继续与政策制定者和公用事业合作，为未来园区安排在电网承压时减少电力需求。为改善公众形象，OpenAI已将其AI数据中心改称为“计算园区”（compute campuses），以与数据中心较差的社会声誉保持距离。

性能与对比数据方面，1000兆瓦的释放能力相当于约70万户家庭空调负荷；而犹他州博克斯埃尔德县获批项目的预计耗电量超过该州2025年峰值需求的两倍，显示出大型数据中心对局部电网的巨大压力。HARC研究则提示，得州拟议数据中心项目可能带来显著空气质量倒退。多州立法和暂停令表明，数据中心新增电力成本由谁承担、环境外部性如何控制，已成为AI基础设施扩张的关键政策问题。该计划的影响和应用场景包括：在极端天气、电网高峰和紧急事件中提供可调用容量；通过需求响应协议让数据中心参与电网调节；以全年稳定负荷帮助分摊电网固定成本；并可能复制到OpenAI与Oracle、SoftBank合作建设的“星际之门”（Stargate）数据中心项目中，包括得克萨斯州沙克尔福德县、新墨西哥州多尼亚安娜县和得克萨斯州米拉姆县。不过，该模式也面临争议：配套建设发电厂可能带来排放和社区影响，批评者可能质疑其是否真正降低居民负担，而非以公关方式缓解数据中心扩张阻力。

history.title: Putin demands Russian data centers supply capacity to the state in wake of Ukraine drone attacks
history.description: President Putin has told non-state Russian data centers that they must set aside 10% of their total capacity for use by the country's own IT infrastructure.

history.titleZh: 普京要求俄数据中心在乌克兰无人机袭击后向国家提供算力
history.descriptionZh:
俄罗斯政府正要求非国有数据中心预留10%的算力容量，以便在国家需要时快速支援国有IT基础设施。路透社称，这一要求由总统普京提出，目标是未来在国有系统需要时能够迅速释放额外数据中心算力。普京已指示数字发展部盘点全国私有数据中心的可用算力容量和机房空间；新成立的政府委员会将有权下令释放被预留的数据中心容量，第三方数据中心所有者收到命令后须在24小时内执行。政府还提出可临时使用位于俄罗斯境外的数据中心，但需获得俄联邦安全局（FSB）批准。

这一举措的背景是，俄罗斯数据中心近几周成为乌克兰无人机袭击目标，造成严重破坏并影响国有互联网服务。10月初，无人机袭击了俄罗斯最大数据中心，这是两天内第二次此类攻击。该63兆瓦设施受损严重，多个模块被迫完全退出服务；当时用户报告Yandex Mail、Disk、Documents、Pay和Market出现问题，尽管Yandex称关键服务仍运行。两周后，俄财政部数据中心遭乌克兰无人机袭击受损，据报道该设施存放俄罗斯税务数据库及其他国家登记数据。与此同时，俄联邦国家统计局承认其服务器遭网络攻击，23TB数据被盗，据称包括标注“仅供官方使用”的俄罗斯战时损失新数据。

从机制上看，这不是芯片或冷却层面的技术突破，而是国家层面的数据中心容量预留与应急调度机制：通过全面盘点私有设施容量、强制预留10%算力、赋予政府委员会释放权限、设定24小时合规时限，并保留经FSB审批使用境外设施的可能性，形成一套快速征用和切换的应急体系。其核心作用是提升国家IT基础设施在无人机打击、网络攻击和战时压力下的韧性，保障税务、登记、邮件、支付等关键服务。性能参数方面，新闻披露的关键数据包括10%的强制预留比例、63兆瓦大型数据中心受损、多个模块停服、23TB数据被盗，以及俄罗斯此前攻击乌克兰数据中心导致10万户家庭断网。技术影响上，该政策可能压缩商业数据中心的可用容量和云服务弹性，但在应急场景下可为国家关键系统提供快速算力支援；应用场景主要覆盖国有互联网服务、税务和登记数据库、支付与邮件等公共服务，以及战时和重大网络攻击后的恢复保障。

history.title: AI model gets a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled directly into its weights, then runs DOOM on it
history.description: Qwenputer is an experimental blend of the stock Qwen 3.5 4B LLM with a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled and inserted directly into its weights.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AI engineer Divyansh Agrawal has revealed the Qwenputer. Described in its most basic terms, Qwenputer is an experimental blend of the stock Qwen 3.5 4B AI LLM with a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled and inserted directly into its weights. In use, Qwenputer can run processor arithmetic operations – or even run C and MicroPython code on its built-in CPU, eschewing any external runtime or tool use. Moreover, it can run Doom, albeit very slowly. You can see the Qwenputer running Doom on its RISC-V CPU by expanding the tweet below.QWenputer by @divagr1925 is so cool! but... can it run DOOM? Ofc yes! E1M1 on the RISC-V CPU compiled into Qwen3.5-4B weights. will opensource too https://t.co/hEa46rD6CJOctober 29, 2026The implementation of Qwenputer raises some interesting concepts and solutions. For example, the developer used Qwen’s Gated DeltaNet (GND) state as RAM, which Agrawal reckons is “a pretty neat trick.” They admit that using these ‘fast weights’ as RAM isn’t an original concept, but modifying Qwen 3.5 this way does seem to be a first.Unlike traditional LLM creation, adding a ‘CPU’ doesn’t involve training. This RISC-V CPU implementation “is 11 transformer layers in front of Qwen's own, and none of their weights are learned: a compiler computes every one,” it is explained. Agrawal boasts that Qwenputer’s built-in CPU “passes the official riscv-tests, its programs match qemu, and it has run 18 million instructions free-running without a single error.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The developer stresses that Qwen makes use of this ‘CPU’ to send instructions and read them back with no external tool or runtime calls. In practice, it works as intended. Use of the CPU inside Qwenputer provides exact calculations, overcoming the arithmetic weaknesses of many LLMs. Moreover, users can run code on the CPU inside the LLM, with C and MicroPython compatibility.Not content with wedging a CPU into an LLM, Agrawal decided to also give it a filesystem. They describe this extension of the model as relatively trivial, since RAM is already in place. Indeed, the filesystem storage also uses the DeltaNet state. There are 1,024 slots holding up to 512 files. Moreover, this storage is persistent if you save the state at the end of a conversation with the LLM. Thus, Agrawal recommends a workstation with 24GB of VRAM or more for testing Qwenputer in its current version. Efforts are being made to streamline coding in Qwenputer, as well as make it run faster. One gets the impression that Agrawal built Qwenputer primarily as an experiment to explore what is possible, rather than to solve a specific problem. history.titleZh: AI 模型将一个 32 位 RISC-V CPU 直接编译进其权重，然后在其上运行《毁灭战士》
history.descriptionZh:
AI工程师Divyansh Agrawal公开了实验性项目Qwenputer：它将一个32位RISC-V CPU编译并直接插入Qwen 3.5 4B大语言模型的权重中，使模型本身能够执行处理器算术运算，甚至运行C和MicroPython代码，而无需依赖外部运行时或工具调用。该项目还能运行《Doom》，但速度非常慢；演示中E1M1关卡是在编译进Qwen3.5-4B权重的RISC-V CPU上运行的。

Qwenputer的核心创新在于把CPU“嵌入”LLM内部，而不是通过外部工具接口调用计算资源。Agrawal利用Qwen的Gated DeltaNet状态作为RAM，也就是所谓“快速权重”作为内存。他承认把快速权重用作RAM并非原创概念，但以这种方式修改Qwen 3.5似乎尚属首次。与通常的LLM构建方式不同，加入这个“CPU”不涉及训练：该RISC-V CPU实现是位于Qwen原有层之前的11个Transformer层，且这些层的权重都不是学习得到的，而是由编译器计算每一个权重。Agrawal称，内置CPU通过了官方riscv-tests，其程序运行结果与QEMU一致，并且曾自由运行1800万条指令而没有出现一次错误。模型利用这个CPU发送指令并读回结果，不需要外部工具或运行时调用。

在实际效果上，内置CPU为Qwenputer提供了精确计算能力，有助于克服许多LLM在算术上的弱点；用户还可以在LLM内部的CPU上运行代码，并兼容C和MicroPython。Agrawal还进一步为模型增加了文件系统。由于RAM已经就位，这一扩展相对简单；文件系统存储同样使用DeltaNet状态，共有1024个槽位，最多可容纳512个文件。如果在对话结束时保存状态，这些存储内容可以持久保留。

代价是资源占用显著增加：Qwenputer使底层Qwen 3.5 4B模型的大小几乎翻倍，达到近19GB，因此Agrawal建议使用至少24GB显存的 workstation 来测试当前版本。团队也在努力简化Qwenputer中的编码流程并提升运行速度。总体而言，该项目仍属实验性质，更多是探索LLM与CPU深度融合的可能性，而非解决某一具体问题。但它展示了无需外部工具即可在模型内部执行精确计算和代码、并维护持久文件系统的思路，对理解LLM算术可靠性、工具调用替代方案以及模型内部状态利用具有一定启发意义。Qwenputer代码以MIT许可证发布在GitHub，模型也可从Hugging Face获取。

history.title: SpaceX loses bid to dismiss lawsuit over xAI data center pollution
history.description: SpaceX loses latest legal fight over xAI's gas-powered data centers in Mississippi — court rejects arguments that mobile turbines are exempt from air permits
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter SpaceX has suffered a setback after losing in a lawsuit aimed at stopping the Clean Air Act requirements on the turbines powering xAI’s Colossus 2 data center in Southaven, Mississippi. According to a report by CNBC, a judge rejected the company’s motion to dismiss the case on Friday, October 30, allowing the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP) to proceed, rejecting xAI’s argument that its turbines fall under the ‘mobile sources’ category that exempts it from air permitting requirements.The case, brought in April 2026 by the NAACP and represented by the Southern Environmental Law Center (SELC) alongside Earthjustice, targets xAI’s operation of a gas-fired power plant to supply electricity to its facility in the Greater Memphis area. SpaceX owns and operates xAI, implicating Elon Musk's wider aerospace and technology company.According to court documents, NACCP accuses xAI and its subsidiary, MZX Tech, of installing 27 gas turbines in Southaven last year without obtaining the required permits. The applicants also argued that the company’s equipment has been polluting the environment through nitrogen oxide emissions and fine particulate matter, which can contribute to breath-related hazards to residents. The SELC particularly says the plant could emit over 5,00 tons of nitrogen oxides, 400 tons of fine particulate matter, and 47 tons of formaldehyde — a cancer-causing chemical — annually.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The judge also rejected xAI’s attempted classification of the turbines as mobile equipment, holding that the company did not qualify for exemptions under applicable regulations and that the turbines were not exempt from Clean Air Act permitting requirements. Just two weeks earlier, SpaceX suffered another setback after the same court rejected a separate Department of Justice lawsuit that argued against the case proceeding.“This decision is another important victory in our effort to hold xAI accountable. The courts have repeatedly rejected attempts by xAI and the DOJ to dismiss the NAACP’s Clean Air Act case, affirming our right to pursue justice for communities impacted by pollution. Our position has been clear: xAI cannot operate gas turbines without the required permits. Now that the motion to dismiss has been denied, we look forward to continuing to defend our position in court,” Abre’ Conner, NAACP Director of Environmental and Climate Justice, said. SpaceX is yet to comment on the ruling. history.titleZh: SpaceX未能驳回就xAI数据中心污染提起的诉讼
history.descriptionZh:
SpaceX在围绕xAI“Colossus 2”数据中心供电设施的法律战中遭遇挫折。据CNBC报道，法官于10月30日驳回SpaceX要求驳回诉讼的动议，允许美国全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）继续推进其依据《清洁空气法》提起的诉讼。案件焦点是xAI在密西西比州Southaven为孟菲斯地区数据中心运营燃气发电设施。NAACP及其代理律师——南方环境法律中心（SELC）和Earthjustice——于2026年4月起诉，指控xAI及其子公司MZX Tech去年在Southaven安装27台燃气轮机但未取得所需空气排放许可，并称这些设备排放氮氧化物和细颗粒物，可能危害居民呼吸健康。SELC称，该电厂每年可能排放超过500吨氮氧化物、400吨细颗粒物以及47吨可致癌的甲醛。xAI曾主张这些涡轮机属于可豁免空气许可要求的“移动源”，但法官拒绝这一分类，认定其不符合适用法规下的豁免条件，涡轮机不能免于《清洁空气法》的许可要求。NAACP环境与气候正义主任Abre’ Conner称，这是追究xAI责任的又一重要胜利，法院已多次拒绝xAI和美国司法部试图驳回案件的做法，并强调xAI不能在缺少许可的情况下运行燃气轮机。SpaceX尚未对裁决置评。

这起诉讼的背景是AI数据中心对电力的巨大需求。Colossus 2位于孟菲斯，7月已安装59台天然气涡轮机，立即引发居民对排放和社区影响的担忧。该设施计划在四栋建筑中部署约86万块Nvidia GB300 GPU，甚至可能更多；马斯克称到年底Colossus 2将有约120万块Blackwell系列GPU。具体而言，“Macroharder”和“Minihard”各配置22万块GB300，使用800G网卡，面向训练；“Gun Range”配置22万块GB300，目标11月底投入运行；“Spam”约20万块GB300，面向推理，目标12月上线。四栋建筑合计约86万块GB300。推理集群“Spam”所需网络更简单，光纤用量不到训练建筑的一半。报道还称，马斯克曾在午夜和次日早晨亲自巡视整个Colossus 2现场，SpaceX相关团队正以极快速度组装算力设施。

从技术上看，Colossus 2体现了两类AI负载的差异化设计：训练集群需要高带宽、低延迟网络和大量光纤连接，以支撑大规模并行训练；推理集群则可采用更简化的网络架构，降低成本和部署复杂度。GB300是Nvidia新一代Blackwell架构GPU，单机性能和显存能力提升，使单集群规模可达数十万块GPU。但如此规模的算力集群也带来巨大供电压力，xAI选择自建燃气发电设施以快速上线，却因此触发清洁空气许可争议。此次判决的核心法律意义在于，法院不接受将燃气轮机简单归类为“移动源”来规避固定源排放许可，这将对AI数据中心自备电厂和快速部署模式形成合规约束。

此前，同一法院已在两周前驳回美国司法部试图阻止案件推进的另一项诉讼；6月司法部曾以Colossus 2支持关键国家安全行动为由请求驳回NAACP诉讼，但未获支持。8月，公司表示将移除未获许可的涡轮发电机，并替换为规模更大的获许可电厂，但这可能需要至少一年。近期SpaceX还开始内部制造涡轮叶片，以加快xAI数据中心发电机的生产。总体来看，此案不仅关乎Colossus 2的供电安排，也涉及AI基础设施扩张中算力、电力、环境合规与社区健康之间的张力；若诉讼持续推进，可能影响数据中心上线节奏，并为类似“自备燃气电厂+AI集群”模式树立监管先例。
